record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Unto thee, O LORD<WH03068>, do I lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315>.

Good<WH02896> and upright<WH03477> <FI>is<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>: therefore will he teach<WH03384><WTH8686> sinners<WH02400> in the way<WH01870>.

For thy name's<WH08034> sake, O LORD<WH03068>, pardon<WH05545><WTH8804> mine iniquity<WH05771>; for it <FI>is<Fi> great<WH07227>.
What man<WH0376> <FI>is<Fi> he that feareth<WH03373> the LORD<WH03068>? him shall he teach<WH03384><WTH8686> in the way<WH01870> <FI>that<Fi> he shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799>.

Mine eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> ever<WH08548> toward the LORD<WH03068>; for he shall pluck<WH03318><WTH8686> my feet<WH07272> out of the net<WH07568>. <RF>pluck: Heb. bring forth<Rf>

Consider<WH07200><WTH8798> mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>; for they are many<WH07231><WTH8804>; and they hate<WH08130><WTH8804> me with cruel<WH02555> hatred<WH08135>. <RF>cruel...: Heb. hatred of violence<Rf>
O keep<WH08104><WTH8798> my soul<WH05315>, and deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me: let me not be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>; for I put my trust<WH02620><WTH8804> in thee.
Let integrity<WH08537> and uprightness<WH03476> preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> me; for I wait<WH06960><WTH8765> on thee.
Redeem<WH06299><WTH8798> Israel<WH03478>, O God<WH0430>, out of all his troubles<WH06869>.<CM>
